# Data Table

```tsx
import { DataTable, DataTableBulkActionBar, DataTableHeader, DataTablePagination } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Serve para exibir dados estruturados em formato tabular, permitindo análise e interação por meio de recursos como ordenação, filtros e seleção.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<DataTable
  {...args}
  key={`${items}-${selectedCount}`}
  info={info || undefined}
  rows={rows}
  columns={columns}
  getRowId={(row) => row.id}
  defaultSelectedRows={firstRowIds(rows, selectedCount)}
  actions={listedActions(actionCount)}
  moreActions={showMoreActions ? moreActions : undefined}
  bulkActions={listedBulkActions(bulkActionCount)}
  bulkMoreActions={showBulkMoreActions ? moreActions : undefined}
  rowActionsType={showActions ? rowActionsType : undefined}
  rowActions={() => rowActions}
/>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Data Table: the Data Table Header, the .Bulk Action Bar, a Table and the Pagination Data Table row, 24px apart. It works from `rows` and `columns`: the search, the sorting, the selection across pages and the pagination all live here, because they have to see every row, not one page. DataTableHeader, DataTableBulkActionBar and DataTablePagination are exported for a table that keeps its data elsewhere.
The header and the bar follow their own width, not the window's, so they also adapt inside a narrow panel. Under 896px they take the Figma Mobile versions and keep the rest in the More menu, on the Bottom Sheet. Just above that, three bar actions drop to a second line. The bar only shows with a selection.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`DataTableActionsProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actions?` | `TableAction[]` | Figma .Action List Actions, from Action 1. |
| `moreActions?` | `TableAction[]` | Figma More Actions: the options of the menu at the end. |
| `direction?` | `DataTableActionsDirection` | Figma Direction: Right To Left puts Action 1 on the right. |
| `primary?` | `boolean` | Figma Primary: Action 1 is a Button Primary. |
| `inverse?` | `boolean` | Figma .Action List Inverse, on Background/Inverse/Default. |

`DataTableMenuProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sections` | `TableAction[][]` | Figma .Dropdown Action Item List: the sections of the menu. |
| `trigger` | `React.ReactElement` | The button that opens the menu. |
| `mobile?` | `boolean` | Figma Mobile: opens as a Bottom Sheet. |

`DataTableHeaderProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Título. |
| `subtitle?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Subtitle: shows when there is one. |
| `info?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Icon Info, with this content in a tooltip. |
| `showSearch?` | `boolean` | Figma Show Search. |

`DataTableBulkActionBarProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `selectedCount?` | `number` | Figma Selected: with none, the bar does not show. |
| `pageRowCount?` | `number` | The rows on the page, for Select Page. |
| `rowCount?` | `number` | The rows in the whole list, for Select List. |
| `showSelectPage?` | `boolean` | Figma Show Select Page. |
| `showSelectList?` | `boolean` | Figma Show Select List. |
| `onClear?` | `() => void` | The X button: clears the selection, which closes the bar. |

`DataTablePaginationProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rowCount` | `number` | The rows in the whole list. |
| `pageSizeOptions?` | `number[]` | The options of the rows per page field. |

`DataTableProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `getRowId` | `(row: Row) => string` | Identifies a row in the selection. |
| `isRowDisabled?` | `(row: Row) => boolean` | Figma State Disabled of a row. |
| `showActionBar?` | `boolean` | Figma Show Action Bar. |
| `showPagination?` | `boolean` | Figma Show Pagination. |
| `actionsDirection?` | `DataTableActionsDirection` | Figma Direction of the header .Action List. |
| `actionsPrimary?` | `boolean` | Figma Primary of the header .Action List. |
| `bulkActions?` | `TableAction[]` | The .Action List Inverse of the .Bulk Action Bar. |
| `bulkActionsDirection?` | `DataTableActionsDirection` | Figma Direction of the bar .Action List Inverse. |
| `selectable?` | `boolean` | Adds the selection column. The bar needs it. |
| `rowActionsType?` | `TableActionsType` | Figma .Table Actions Type of the rows. |
| `rowActions?` | `(row: Row) => TableAction[]` | What each row offers in its actions column. |
| `fixedColumns?` | `boolean` | Figma Fixed Columns: the first column, the selection and the actions. |
| `overflowMethod?` | `TableOverflowMethod` | What long text does in the Table. |
| `loading?` | `boolean` | Figma Loading of the Table. |
| `defaultSort?` | `TableSortState` | The column sorting the table at first, instead of the first sortable. |
| `emptyState?` | `React.ReactNode` | Replaces the Empty State of a list with no rows. |

## Rules

- Import `DataTable` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
